name: Analytical Refractive Index Gradient and Hessian for Acousto-Optic Modulation
definition: A method to compute the scalar refractive index gradient and Hessian analytically for in-situ acousto-optic spatial modulation, avoiding spline interpolation by using known analytical expressions for the refractive index profile.
summary: This method computes exact refractive index gradients and Hessians for acousto-optic modulation using Bessel functions, avoiding numerical approximations.
